podpis.desc: Hands holding a pen and signing a formal document on a dark surface
podpis.why: Hand signing a document with a pen, clear meaning.

pohar.desc: a glass of water on a reflective surface
pohar.why: Plain glass of water on white; L is a teacup.

poharik.desc: a shot glass sitting on top of a wooden table
poharik.why: Single small faceted shot glass, fills the frame.

pohladnica.desc: Hand holding 'greetings from' postcard before bookshelves
pohladnica.why: Hand holding a classic picture postcard, instantly readable.

poklad.desc: a wooden box filled with lots of coins
poklad.why: Wooden box full of gold coins reads as treasure.

pole.why: Wide open wheat field under blue sky.

policajt.desc: a woman in a police uniform standing on the side of the road
policajt.why: German police officer in uniform with Polizei patch, European context.

policia.desc: a police van parked on the side of the road
policia.why: European police van front with large POLIZEI lettering.

polievka.why: Bowl of clear noodle broth, typical Slovak soup.

polnohospodar.desc: man standing on garden during daytime
polnohospodar.why: Friendly farmer standing in his crop field.

portret.why: Classic head-and-shoulders painted portrait; Unsplash tiles are scenes.

posta.desc: A red brick building with "postamt" under a blue sky
posta.why: European brick post office building with POSTAMT lettering.

postel.desc: a bed with a white comforter and pillows
postel.why: Neatly made bed centred in a simple bedroom.

stol.desc: a wooden table sitting on top of a tiled floor
stol.why: A whole table against a plain wall; the other hits were wood textures.

vlak.desc: a train pulling into a train station next to a platform
vlak.why: Modern regional train at a platform, like those in Slovakia.

zena.desc: woman in floral-themed cardigan leaning on fence in bokeh photography
zena.why: Natural, friendly portrait; face reads clearly at thumbnail size.
